name: reverse engineer a binary client-server network protocol
definition: Study the client and server source to determine the handshake, framing, and authentication message format for a custom network protocol.
failure_mode: Wrong opcodes, framing, or payload layout fails the handshake.

name: rstan/pystan posterior-sampling workflow
definition: Write/port Stan model code (R-hosted to pystan where needed), configure the posterior sampling run with fixed seed/chain settings, and extract posterior expectations while persisting results.
failure_mode: A mis-translated mapping/distribution/mean-structure biases posterior means out of range.
